def VTask.comk : {α : Type u_1} → (p : Set α → Prop) → (he : p ∅) → (hmono : ∀ (t : Set α), p t → ∀ s ⊆ t, p s) → (hunion : ∀ (s : Set α), p s → ∀ (t : Set α), p t → p (s ∪ t)) → Filter α
  | α, p, he, hmono, hunion =>
    {
      set : Set (Set α) := { s : Set α | p sᶜ }
      nonempty := ⟨univ, by
        -- Prove that `univ` is in the filter, i.e., `p (∅)` holds.
        have h : (univ : Set α)ᶜ = (∅ : Set α) := by
          ext x
          simp [Set.mem_compl_iff]
          <;> tauto
        rw [h]
        exact he
      ⟩
      upward_closed := fun s hs t ht =>
        -- Prove that if `s ⊆ t`, then `t` is in the filter.
        have h : tᶜ ⊆ sᶜ := by
          intro x hx
          simp only [Set.mem_compl_iff] at hx ⊢
          intro h₁
          have : x ∈ t := ht h₁
          exact hx this
        -- Use the downward closure of `p` to conclude.
        have h₁ : p sᶜ := hs
        have h₂ : p tᶜ := hmono sᶜ h₁ tᶜ h
        exact h₂
      intersection : ∀ s t, s ∈ ({ s : Set α | p sᶜ } : Set (Set α)) → t ∈ ({ s : Set α | p sᶜ } : Set (Set α)) → s ∩ t ∈ ({ s : Set α | p sᶜ } : Set (Set α)) := by
        intro s t hs ht
        -- Prove that `s ∩ t` is in the filter.
        have h₁ : p sᶜ := hs
        have h₂ : p tᶜ := ht
        have h₃ : p (sᶜ ∪ tᶜ) := hunion sᶜ h₁ tᶜ h₂
        have h₄ : (s ∩ t)ᶜ = sᶜ ∪ tᶜ := by
          ext x
          simp [Set.mem_compl_iff, Set.mem_inter_iff, Set.mem_union]
          <;> tauto
        rw [h₄]
        exact h₃
    }
